name: Pantheon
key_features: A concrete dome as wide as it is high, lit only by the oculus.

name: Villa La Rotonda
key_features: A square plan with four porticoes: the villa that later classical houses copied.

name: Walt Disney Concert Hall
key_features: Vineyard-style hall wrapped in curved stainless steel sails modelled with aerospace software.

name: National Museum of Western Art
key_features: Square spiral plan on pilotis around a top-lit central hall, laid out to grow outward.

name: National Museum of African American History and Culture
key_features: Three-tiered inverted corona clad in a bronze-coloured cast aluminium lattice over a glazed base.

name: Guangzhou Opera House
key_features: Two faceted boulder-like volumes of granite and glass rest on a riverside landscaped plaza.

name: Scottish Parliament Building
key_features: Leaf-shaped roofs over the debating chamber, and timber-framed window seats for members.

name: Lever House
key_features: Thin glass slab set over a raised podium and open plaza, an early sealed curtain wall.

name: Torre Velasca
key_features: Upper residential floors cantilever out on angled ribs over the narrower office shaft.

name: Louvre Pyramid
key_features: Glass and steel pyramid lights an underground hall that links the museum's wings.

name: Museum of Modern Art, Rio de Janeiro
key_features: Gallery floors hung from external concrete frames, leaving column-free rooms and an open ground level.

name: Military History Museum
key_features: A steel and glass wedge slices through the old arsenal, pointing toward where the bombing began.

name: St. Joseph's Church
key_features: Octagonal lantern tower lined with thousands of coloured glass pieces rises over the altar.

name: Yale Center for British Art
key_features: Concrete frame infilled with matte steel panels, two courts and skylit galleries of oak and linen.

name: National Museum of Qatar
key_features: Interlocking curved discs modelled on the desert rose crystal wrap around a restored old palace.

name: Saint-Pierre, Firminy
key_features: Truncated concrete cone, square below and round above, with points of light like stars.

name: Oakland Museum of California
key_features: Terraced concrete galleries whose roofs are gardens for the level above, a museum as landscape.

name: Kaleva Church
key_features: Curved concrete wall segments separated by tall slit windows on a fish-shaped plan.

name: Helsinki Central Library Oodi
key_features: A spruce-clad timber wave bridges an open ground floor, under a top-floor reading room called book heaven.

name: Kursaal
key_features: Two tilted translucent glass prisms read as rocks on the shore, glowing at night.

name: Vanna Venturi House
key_features: Split gable facade over a broken arch, with chimney and stair competing for the centre of the plan.

name: New Museum
key_features: Stack of shifted boxes in aluminium mesh; the offsets bring skylights down to the galleries.

name: Portland Building
key_features: Cubic block with giant painted pilasters, keystone and small square windows applied as graphics.

name: Viipuri Library
key_features: Round conical skylights light the reading room; undulating timber ceiling in the lecture hall.

name: Marina City
key_features: Twin corncob towers of petal-shaped balconies above spiral parking ramps, all in cast concrete.

name: National Taichung Theater
key_features: Curved concrete catenoid walls form a continuous cave of horizontal and vertical tubes.

name: Fondation Maeght
key_features: Quarter-cylinder roof scoops catch daylight for galleries set among garden courts.

name: Villa Müller
key_features: Raumplan: rooms of different heights interlock in section around a split-level stair.

name: Portugal Pavilion
key_features: A thin concrete canopy hangs like a sheet between two porticoes over a ceremonial plaza.

name: VM Houses
key_features: V and M shaped blocks with split-level flats and pointed balconies spiking out.

name: Villa Cavrois
key_features: Long symmetrical house clad in thin yellow brick, on an axis with a reflecting pool.

name: Stockholm Public Library
key_features: Cylindrical rotunda reading room rises from a cubic base, books lining the drum.

name: Mountain Dwellings
key_features: Terraced flats with gardens stepped up over a sloping multi-storey car park beneath.

name: The Met
key_features: Slender towers with sky gardens and cross-ventilated flats, linked by open breezeways.

name: Kaufmann Desert House
key_features: Pinwheel plan of wings reaching into the desert, with sliding glass walls and a rooftop gloriette.

name: Kirche am Steinhof
key_features: Marble panels fixed with visible bolts cloak a brick shell under a gilded dome.

name: Schindler House
key_features: Tilt-up concrete wall slabs with glass slits; L-shaped studios each open onto a garden court.

name: Torino Esposizioni (Hall B)
key_features: Undulating vault of prefabricated ferrocement units with glazing between the ribs.

name: Maison de Verre
key_features: Glass block walls and an exposed steel frame inserted beneath an existing apartment.

name: Hilversum town hall
key_features: Interlocking brick volumes build up asymmetrically to a clock tower beside a long pond.

name: Parliament House
key_features: Building dug into a hill with grass ramps over its roof, crowned by a four-legged steel flagmast.

name: Stuttgart TV Tower
key_features: Tapering reinforced concrete shaft on a shallow ring foundation, the prototype TV tower.

name: MuCEM
key_features: A square box wrapped in a lace-like screen of ultra-high-performance concrete, with ramps behind it.

name: Shukhov Tower
key_features: Stacked hyperboloid sections of straight steel members, each lifted up inside the last.

name: Louisiana Museum of Modern Art
key_features: Low glazed corridors link galleries from an old villa through parkland to the sea.

name: Thorncrown Chapel
key_features: Lattice of small pine members, sized to be carried by hand, braced inside a glass box in the woods.

name: Universita Luigi Bocconi Building
key_features: Office floors hang from deep concrete beams above a sunken aula, with daylight dropping through slots.

name: Montreal Biosphère
key_features: Steel-tube geodesic dome 76 m across, once skinned with acrylic cells and sun shades.

name: The Interlace
key_features: Thirty-one six-storey blocks stacked in a hexagonal weave, forming large garden courtyards.

name: Robson Square
key_features: Three-block civic landscape of stepped terraces, water and a sloped glass roof over the law courts.

name: Museo Tamayo
by: Teodoro González de León, Abraham Zabludovsky
key_features: Bush-hammered concrete with marble aggregate, in stepped platform-like masses set low in the park.

name: Niterói Contemporary Art Museum
key_features: Flared saucer on one central cylinder above a reflecting pool, reached by a red ramp, with wide bay views.

name: Gustavo Capanema Palace
key_features: Office slab on tall pilotis, with adjustable brise-soleil on the sun facade and tile murals at ground level.

name: Pedregulho Housing
key_features: Serpentine slab follows the hillside contour, entered by bridges at an open middle floor screened by cobogo.

name: Pinacoteca do Estado de São Paulo
key_features: Glass roofs over the old brick courtyards and steel bridges across them reorganise a former academy.

name: National Library of Argentina
key_features: Reading rooms lifted on four massive concrete supports above a park, with the book stacks buried below.

name: Washington Dulles Airport Terminal
key_features: Concrete roof hung in a catenary curve between two rows of outward-leaning pylons.

name: TWA Flight Center
key_features: Four thin concrete shells meet on Y-shaped piers, curving into a fluid interior lit by skylight seams.

name: Gateway Arch
key_features: Weighted catenary arch of triangular stainless-steel-clad sections, with tram cars running up its legs.

name: Robie House
key_features: Long cantilevered roofs and Roman brick bands, with living spaces flowing around a central hearth.

name: Unity Temple
key_features: Poured-concrete cube with a coffered skylit ceiling and clerestories, entered through low cloisters.

name: Toronto-Dominion Centre
key_features: Black steel and bronze-glass towers on a granite plaza, with a single-storey banking pavilion.

name: John Hancock Center
key_features: Tapering tower whose exterior X-braced tube resists wind, stacking shops, offices and flats.

name: PSFS Building
key_features: T-shaped office slab cantilevered beyond its columns, over a raised banking hall and curved base.

name: Ford Foundation Building
key_features: L-shaped offices look onto a full-height glazed garden atrium set inside the block.

name: Wainwright Building
key_features: Steel-frame office block with tall brick piers, a two-storey base and a deep terracotta frieze.

name: Glass Pavilion, Toledo Museum of Art
key_features: Curved glass-walled rooms float in a square plan, separated by air cavities that buffer heat.

name: Gunma Museum of Modern Art
key_features: Open cubic frames clad in square aluminium panels; one wing turns off the grid over a pool.

name: Tsukuba Center Building
key_features: A sunken oval plaza inverts the Campidoglio, framed by blocks that quote fragments of past architecture.

name: Tama Art University Library
key_features: Thin concrete-encased steel arches in varying spans cross on a gently sloping ground floor.

name: Suzhou Museum
key_features: White walls with grey stone-trimmed roofs around a water garden; geometric skylights light the galleries.

name: Harbin Opera House
key_features: White aluminium-clad volumes rise from the wetland; the main hall is lined in carved Manchurian ash.

name: Tai Kwun
key_features: A restored police compound with two new blocks clad in cast-aluminium bricks, one raised over the yard.

name: Jongmyo Shrine
key_features: A long low hall of repeated bays on a broad stone platform, extended as ancestral tablets accumulated.

name: Menara Mesiniaga
key_features: Spiralling sky gardens, sunshades on hot facades and a rooftop sun-roof frame cool a round tower.

name: Rose Seidler House
key_features: A raised open-plan box on a stone base, with a ramp to a deck and a mural on the terrace wall.

name: Shine Dome
key_features: A shallow concrete dome resting on arches that dip into a surrounding moat.

name: Federation Square
key_features: Pinwheel-tiled facades of sandstone, zinc and glass frame a sloping paved square built over rail lines.

name: Royal National Theatre
key_features: Board-marked concrete terraces step toward the Thames, linking three auditoria through open foyers.

name: Sainsbury Centre for Visual Arts
key_features: Deep steel trusses hold services within the walls and roof, leaving one column-free gallery shed.

name: Isokon Building
key_features: Compact reinforced concrete flats reached by cantilevered external access galleries and an end stair.

name: Sir John Soane's Museum
key_features: Domes, lanterns and hidden skylights draw daylight down through narrow, layered rooms full of casts.

name: Fondation Cartier
key_features: Free-standing glass screens extend past the building, blurring its edges with the garden trees.

name: Millau Viaduct
key_features: Tapering concrete piers and cable-stayed masts carry a thin steel deck high across the Tarn valley.

name: Pavillon Le Corbusier
key_features: A bolted steel parasol roof hovers over a pavilion of coloured enamelled panels and glass.

name: Park Güell
key_features: Leaning rubble viaducts follow the hillside; a serpentine tiled bench edges a terrace over a column hall.

name: Igualada Cemetery
key_features: A descending path cut into a former quarry, lined with concrete niche walls and stone-filled gabions.

name: Gimnasio Maravillas
key_features: A gym under a school playground on a steep slope, with curved steel trusses that house classrooms.

name: Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe
key_features: A field of 2,711 concrete stelae of varying height on undulating ground, forming narrow aisles.

name: Van Nelle Factory
key_features: Mushroom-column concrete frame behind continuous curtain walls, with glazed conveyor bridges.

name: WoZoCo
key_features: Flats that did not fit the slab hang off the north side as large timber-clad cantilevered boxes.

name: Saint Benedict Chapel
key_features: Leaf-shaped timber chapel clad in larch shingles, with a band of clerestory windows below the roof.

name: Fondation Beyeler
key_features: Long porphyry walls under a floating glass roof that filters daylight into galleries beside a pond.

name: Secession Building
key_features: White cubic exhibition hall with top-lit galleries, crowned by a dome of gilded iron laurel leaves.

name: Grundtvig's Church
key_features: Organ-pipe stepped west front and tall Gothic-inspired vaults built entirely of yellow brick.

name: Szczecin Philharmonic
key_features: Translucent glass skin with sharp gabled peaks that glows at night, around a gold-lined concert hall.

name: Ještěd Tower
key_features: Hyperboloid summit tower combining a TV transmitter, hotel and restaurant, clad in aluminium panels.

name: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore
key_features: Long corridors under open pergolas link courts and classrooms built of rough granite and concrete.

name: India Habitat Centre
key_features: Brick and concrete blocks around linked courts shaded by high space-frame canopies.

name: Jantar Mantar, Jaipur
key_features: Masonry astronomical instruments at architectural scale, shaped to read the sun's shadow.
